notes: Adaptive semantic LLM mode enabled via TKNT_SEMANTIC_ADAPTIVE_LLM; deterministic stage fallbacks are disabled.
Kept the canonical bedroom structure and added only a minimal work-study cluster because the brief explicitly requests a small desk or vanity if space allows and the room has sufficient area.
Did not add a vanity-specific cluster because no vanity object type exists in the allowed inventory; desk is the closest supported substitute.
Tier hints are set to preserve the bed and one storage anchor, allow two nightstands only when space permits, and treat lounge/work pieces as surplus-sensitive support items.
Room area is comfortable for the requested bedroom suite, so core sleep and storage should be preserved and small support items should not be over-pruned when surplus exists.
Desk/work is optional but plausible only if circulation and daylight remain open; lounge reading is also viable but should yield to bed/storage first.
Media is not supported by the brief and should usually drop.
Utility storage is not a design priority for this room and should remain low priority unless explicitly needed.
Active clusters mapped to bedroom priorities; bed zone is primary, storage secondary, work and lounge optional.
Window daylight and open center preserved for work/lounge only when space allows; entry clearance and circulation kept clear.
Request contract LLM mode enabled via TKNT_REQUEST_CONTRACT_LLM; deterministic validation remains active.
SemanticLayoutPlanner used the room profile registry as the canonical rule source.
Planner output is cluster/bundle/zone level only; pose is left to downstream composer and solver.
Style policy compiled before layout planning; downstream geometry treats it as bias, not a hard override.
Request contract attached before tier count so explicit functional objects are protected from silent pruning.
Tier Count used deterministic utility, capacity, and bundle-preserving rules, plus Forge semantic tier-count hints when available.
Tier Count itself did not run an additional LLM call.
Output is synchronized for the object-level anchor-first solver handoff.
Merged into solver-ready object program for object-level anchor-first placement.
Bedroom correction raised restfulness and clutter control.
